tactics: intros; simp only [List.removeAll, List.filter_filter]; apply List.filter_congr; intro x _; cases h : x == y <;> simp [List.elem_cons, h]
intro α _ xs y ys; induction xs <;> simp_all [List.removeAll, List.filter, List.elem_cons] <;> split <;> simp_all
intros; unfold List.removeAll; rw [List.filter_filter]; apply List.filter_congr; intro x _; cases h : x == y <;> simp [List.elem, h]
